311_service_requests: Entity: 311 service requests; Grain: one row per reported service request (unique_key); Keys/Measures: unique_key (PK), created_date, closed_date, resolution_action_updated_date, status, status_notes, agency_name, category, complaint_type, descriptor, incident_address, supervisor_district, neighborhood, location, source, media_url, latitude, longitude, police_district.
bikeshare_regions: Entity: bikeshare regions; Grain: one row per region (region_id); Keys/Measures: region_id (PK), name.
bikeshare_station_info: Entity: bikeshare station metadata; Grain: one row per station (station_id); Keys/Measures: station_id (PK), name, short_name, lat, lon, region_id, rental_methods, capacity, external_id, eightd_has_key_dispenser, has_kiosk, station_geom.
bikeshare_station_status: Entity: real-time/status of bikeshare stations; Grain: one row per station status snapshot (station_id + last_reported); Keys/Measures: station_id, num_bikes_available, num_bikes_disabled, num_docks_available, num_docks_disabled, is_installed, is_renting, is_returning, last_reported, num_ebikes_available, eightd_has_available_keys.
bikeshare_trips: Entity: individual bikeshare trips; Grain: one row per trip (trip_id); Keys/Measures: trip_id (PK), duration_sec, start_date, start_station_name, start_station_id, end_date, end_station_name, end_station_id, bike_number, zip_code, subscriber_type, c_subscription_type, start_station_latitude, start_station_longitude, end_station_latitude, end_station_longitude, member_birth_year, member_gender, bike_share_for_all_trip, start_station_geom, end_station_geom.
film_locations: Entity: film/TV shoot records; Grain: one row per filmed title/location combination (title + locations); Keys/Measures: title, release_year, locations, fun_facts, production_company, distributor, director, writer, actor_1, actor_2, actor_3.
boundaries: Entity: neighborhood boundary geometries and internal point; Grain: one row per neighborhood (neighborhood); Keys/Measures: neighborhood, internal_point_latitude, internal_point_longitude, internal_point_geom, neighborhood_geom.
sffd_service_calls: Entity: SFFD incident/call records; Grain: one row per service call (call_number / incident_number); Keys/Measures: call_number, unit_id, incident_number, call_type, call_date, watch_date, received_timestamp, entry_timestamp, dispatch_timestamp, response_timestamp, on_scene_timestamp, transport_timestamp, hospital_timestamp, call_final_disposition, available_timestamp, address, city, zipcode_of_incident, battalion, station_area, box, original_priority, priority, final_priority, als_unit, call_type_group, number_of_alarms, unit_type, unit_sequence_in_call_dispatch, fire_prevention_district, supervisor_district, row_id, latitude, longitude, neighborhood_name, location_geom.
sfpd_incidents: Entity: SFPD incident reports; Grain: one row per police incident (unique_key); Keys/Measures: unique_key, category, descript, dayofweek, pddistrict, resolution, address, longitude, latitude, location, pdid, timestamp.
calendar: Entity: transit service calendar definitions; Grain: one row per service_id/calendar rule; Keys/Measures: service_id, service_desc, sunday, monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, exceptions, exception_type.
stop_monitoring: Entity: vehicle/stop monitoring snapshots; Grain: one row per monitored stop event (time_recorded + stop_id + trip_id); Keys/Measures: time_recorded, stop_id, stop_name, route_id, direction, trip_date, trip_id, route_long_name, vehicle_location_lat, vehicle_location_lon, vehicle_location, vehicle_id, vehicle_at_stop, aimed_arrival_time, aimed_departure_time.
shapes: Entity: route shape points for trips; Grain: one row per shape point (shape_id + shape_point_sequence); Keys/Measures: shape_id, shape_point_sequence, shape_point_lat, shape_point_lon, shape_point_geom, shape_distance_traveled.
stops: Holds transit stop entities; grain = one row per stop (stop_id); notable columns/keys: stop_id (key), stop_name, stop_lat, stop_lon, stop_geom.
trips: Holds transit trip entities; grain = one row per trip (trip_id); notable columns/keys: trip_id (key), route_id, direction, block_id, service_category, trip_headsign, shape_id, trip_shape.
vehicle_monitoring: Holds real-time vehicle monitoring snapshots; grain = one row per vehicle observation at a timestamp (time_recorded + vehicle_id/trip_id); notable columns/keys/measures: time_recorded, vehicle_id, trip_id, route_id, direction, trip_date, route_long_name, vehicle_location_lat, vehicle_location_lon, vehicle_location, next_stop_id, next_stop_name, next_stop_expected_arrival_time, next_stop_aimed_arrival_time, next_stop_expected_departure_time, onward_stop_id_1..5, onward_stop_name_1..5, onward_stop_expected_arrival_time_1..5, onward_stop_aimed_arrival_time_1..5.
fares: Holds fare/payment records; grain = one row per fare transaction or fare type instance (fare_id); notable columns/keys/measures: fare_id (key), rider_id, rider_desc, price, payment_method, transfers_permitted, transfer_duration.
stop_times: Holds scheduled stop times for trips; grain = one row per stop occurrence within a trip (trip_id + stop_sequence or trip_id + stop_id); notable columns/keys/measures: stop_id, trip_id, stop_sequence, arrival_time, arrives_next_day, departure_time, departs_next_day, dropoff_type, exact_timepoint.
routes: Holds transit route definitions; grain = one row per route (route_id); notable columns/keys: route_id (key), route_short_name, route_long_name, route_type.
street_trees: Holds street tree inventory records; grain = one row per tree (tree_id); notable columns/keys/measures: tree_id (key), legal_status, species, address, site_order, site_info, plant_type, care_taker, care_assistant, plant_date, dbh, plot_size, permit_notes, x_coordinate, y_coordinate, latitude, longitude, location.
